summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 trial tests pidnarulex (CX-5461) given together with cemiplimab (REGN2810) in refractory microsatellite stable colorectal cancer. In the arm that receives both drugs, cemiplimab is given IV over 30 minutes on days 1 and 15, and pidnarulex is given IV over 60 minutes on days 1 and 8 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 26 cycles. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study is listed as Phase 1/Phase 2.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa pidnarulex (CX-5461) administrado junto con cemiplimab (REGN2810) en cáncer colorrectal estable para microsatélites refractario. En el brazo que recibe ambos medicamentos, cemiplimab se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos los días 1 y 15, y pidnarulex por vía intravenosa durante 60 minutos los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo de 28 días, hasta 26 ciclos. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio figura como fase 1/fase 2.
who_for: Colorectal adenocarcinoma that is unresectable or metastatic, with no effective standard treatment left
Proficient mismatch repair (pMMR) or not microsatellite-high (non-MSI-H) tumor status
Progressed on or intolerant to fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, irinotecan, bevacizumab, and an EGFR inhibitor
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or better
not_for: Prior RNA polymerase inhibitor, G quadruplex stabilizer, or immunotherapy, including PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitors
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years
Current use of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or strong CYP3A4 inducers
